services.title: RAMS review
services.description: Expert review of your risk assessments and method statements before work starts on site up to 20 documents.

services.title: ISO standards & PQQ completion
services.description: Preparing and submitting a PQQ or accreditation application (CHAS, SSIP, ISO 45001).

services.title: ISO internal audit
services.description: An internal audit of your management system against the standard (ISO 9001, 14001 or 45001), with findings, nonconformities and a report you can put in front of your certification body.

services.title: Policy & document review
services.description: We review and refresh your H&S policy and supporting documents to keep them current and compliant for up to 20 documents.

services.title: Accident / incident investigation
services.description: Root-cause investigation after an accident or near-miss, with corrective actions and RIDDOR reporting guidance/instruction.

services.title: Toolbox talk written to your brief
services.description: We write a talk to your subject and your site, and it lands in your portal to issue and have signed off like any other. Issuing and sign-off are included in your plan; this is the writing.

services.title: Management review meeting
services.description: A structured review of your H&S performance, open actions and priorities with your adviser.

services.title: H&S consultancy
services.description: Ad-hoc advice from your named adviser on any health & safety question as it comes up.

services.title: CDM / contractor support
services.description: Support meeting your CDM duties on construction projects: client duties, principal contractor coordination and documentation.

services.title: General risk assessment
services.description: Task- or area-based risk assessments identifying the hazards and the controls to manage them.

services.title: COSHH assessment
services.description: Assessment of hazardous substances in use, with the controls needed to protect your people.

services.title: DSE assessment
services.description: Display-screen workstation assessments to prevent discomfort and musculoskeletal injury for office staff.

services.title: Legionella risk assessment
services.description: Water system risk assessment to ACOP L8 / HSG274, with a written scheme of control.

services.title: Drug & alcohol testing
services.description: On-site drug & alcohol screening, up to 10 people a visit, to the client's policy.

services.title: Specialist assessment (noise/LEV)
services.description: Specialist monitoring such as noise exposure and LEV (dust/fume extraction) examination and testing.

services.title: Site visit / inspection
services.description: One visit to one site address. Your adviser inspects the site, checks compliance and catches issues early. A second address is a second visit, and travel is charged at cost from each site's own postcode.

services.title: Inspection day
services.description: A day of your adviser's time covering up to three site inspections in one area, for contractors and mobile teams. Travel is charged at cost from the booking postcode.

services.title: Fire Risk Assessment
services.description: Priced per building on what is recorded about it: storeys, floor area, occupancy, sleeping accommodation and anything unusual. Fixed at booking on those facts.

services.title: People on the account
services.description: Everyone recorded on the account and not archived, whatever their role and whether or not they sign in. Sets the band. Subcontractors and their operatives never count.

services.title: Data (storage and traffic)
services.description: The documents, photographs and site captures held on the account, and the ordinary traffic of opening and downloading them, as one combined figure in gigabytes.

services.title: AI-assisted documents
services.description: Documents drafted, extracted or reviewed with AI assistance, counted per month against the tier allowance.

services.title: Emergency First Aid at Work (1-day)
services.description: Emergency First Aid at Work (EFAW) training, one day, including the use of a defibrillator, with a certificate on completion.

services.title: First Aid at Work (3-day)
services.description: First Aid at Work, three days, including defibrillator use, resuscitation, the recovery position, bandaging, choking, asthma and anaphylaxis, with a certificate on completion.

services.title: Training day
services.description: Accredited H&S training delivered to your staff, counted in trainer person-days. This is for general training (Manual Handling, Fire Awareness, Work at Height, Abrasive Wheel, Asbestos)

plans.title: Pay as you go
plans.blurb: No membership. Work is quoted and invoiced per job, and the portal carries their documents and people.

plans.title: Lite
plans.blurb: Everything we issue you, plus the template library to write your own from.

plans.title: Standard
plans.blurb: Run day-to-day H&S yourself: toolbox talks, checks and forms, hazard reporting, your own documents, and your people and their training.

plans.title: Pro
plans.blurb: Everything in Standard plus the specialist work: subcontractor management, ISO and standards, and the full staff compliance record.

plans.title: Managed Service
plans.blurb: We deliver your health & safety. You choose the services to include; we price them to your premises and scope. Includes full Pro portal access.
